download_DiT_model: download a pre-trained DiT model checkpoint from the web using download_model
find_DiT_checkpoint: find and load a pre-trained DiT model or custom checkpoint using find_model
load_custom_DiT_checkpoint: load a custom DiT checkpoint from a local file path using find_model
download_all_DiT_models: download all available pre-trained DiT models by running the script as main
list_pretrained_DiT_models: list available pre-trained DiT model names from the pretrained_models set
